newsitem.title: GERMANY: Karstadt slumps on weaker earnings outlook.
newsitem.headline: Karstadt slumps on weaker earnings outlook.

text.p: Shares in German retailer Karstadt AG slumped in electronic pre-bourse dealings on Monday after it announced on Friday that it expected 1996 earnings to be below the 1995 level.
Karstadt shares fell as much as 29.20 marks ($19.4) to 543 marks from Friday's closing level of 572.20 marks before paring losses to trade down 24.20 marks at 548.20 marks.
Karstadt said in a regulatory statement on Friday that sales in the third quarter had been disappointing but operating earnings had gone according to plan.
The Essen-based retailer said the Christmas sales season would not be enough to balance out the earnings lag against the rest of the year.
